text:
Elaine: heads-up — proposing a temporary PIN cascade for the next unpin window to avoid routing mis-stitches across runtime/SDK when model variants rotate. thinking soft-pin to SDK 2.14 + runtime 3.1 in eu-west for 2 hours.
Matt: can you sketch the exact failure mode briefly? why cascade vs single-layer pin?
Elaine: in the last unpin we saw a kv-cache mismatch + new runtime kernel selector that returns a compatible-but-incompatible model variant. results: increased 5xxs on short seqs and bad latency tails. SDK clients were falling back incorrectly because signature flags differ (header x-rlm-version).
Priya: telemetry backfill shows error rate spike correlated to sdk <-> runtime combos: model: redwood/llama3q:quant-v2 with runtime 3.1-ish. EU regions hit first.
SRE-Oncall: what's the blast radius if we *don't* pin? can degrade SLOs quickly?
Elaine: yes, EU p50/p95 hit for a subset of customers. cascade pin reduces mismatch surface: lock SDK to expect header X and runtime to prefer old kernel path for 120m. not ideal but safe.
Matt: prefer narrower approaches. can we do runtime-only pin + SDK compatibility shim for old header? would avoid touching hosted SDKs.
Priya: SDK shim would need a release and would be slower to ship. runtime-only pin was our prior approach but still left some mobile clients with cached older SDKs hitting the bad path.
deploy-bot: scheduled change window created by Elaine for 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC. Change ID: CHG-20260405-1287.
Elaine: proposed plan: 1) EU-only soft-pin (runtime 3.1, sdk 2.14) for 120m 2) enable additional canary routing to fallback pool 3) monitor: errors, tail latency, client mismatch logs 4) rollback if 5xx > 2% for 10m or customer-impact P1s
Matt: rollback criteria acked. can we add a probe job that hits an instrumented flow? quick curl test.
Elaine: yes — adding a probe hitting embed route + short/long seq variants. snippet: ```
curl -i -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.com/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/llama3q:quant-v2","input":"test short"}'
```
Priya: +1 to EU-only. also request to mute deploybot notifications to #eng-releases during the window except for alerts.
SRE-Oncall: I'll stand by and watch the fallback pool metrics. if warmup fails we cut the pin within 15m.
Matt: sending a quick note to SDK eng to prepare a patch and toggle but mark as opt-in.
Elaine: ok — signoff from everyone? react with :thumbsup: when you agree and I'll flip the schedule to 'go'.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Matt: :thumbsup:
SRE-Oncall: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: CHG-20260405-1287 acknowledged and will post runbook link at 2026-04-05T01:50:00Z.
